market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $105 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI is at $94.7, needing +10.8% to $105 in 4 remaining April trading days. Brent has reached $106, but the WTI-Brent spread is anomalously wide (~$11) due to export disruptions from the Middle East affecting Brent more. For WTI to reach $105, either the spread would need to sharply compress or Brent would need to spike further. Possible but requires an extreme escalation event.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Wide WTI-Brent spread limits WTI upside; would require major new escalation in Hormuz conflict
